name: Proton Saga (1985)
creation_method: Original procedural Blender Python authored with Codex
accuracy_notes: Silver heritage interpretation of the original 1985 four-door Saga sedan, refined from owner-supplied showcase references and Proton heritage imagery. Profiled body, rectangular lamps, horizontal grille, black bumpers, red coachlines and steel wheels are represented with approximate proportions. Smoky glazing reveals a simplified right-hand-drive interior; no engine, opening doors, exact trim or factory paint match is claimed. Reference-image specifications were not independently verified. This is an artistic reconstruction, not a scanned or engineering-accurate replica.
